notes.title: [0.0.5] Content Update, UI Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Frequent updates to add or fix features will happen throughout the early access! To get more insights on our development progress, join our Discord Server!


 New Chest Model for Reward Boxes
 Cards collected can now be viewed via TAB button
 Buff Bar UI to show passives and buffs
 Updated Ability swapping capabilities
 Fixed an issue with continuous ability casting where it will stop working after some time
 Added Mini boss rooms with 1 Miniboss (Mini Treant)
 Added Treant Boss

notes.title: [0.0.3] Multiplayer Fixes & Minor UI Update
notes.notes:
Frequent updates to add or fix features will happen throughout the early access! To get more insights on our development progress, join our Discord Server!

Multiplayer Fixes

 Fixed an issue where maps did not look the same on client and server
 Fixed enemy outlines not showing on client side
 Changed Enemy outline color to red
 Fixed Text Chat not showing up on client side


Minor UI Update

 Added the Dungeon UI Indicator to show the progress of the dungeon
